Open a GEO series (GSE) as GeneFox's GEO Expression screen does and report one gene or probe: its...

gf_geo_series_expression.Rd

Open a GEO series (GSE) as GeneFox's GEO Expression screen does and report one gene or probe: its distribution, or grouped by a sample characteristic with GeneFox's test line and figure, split by a second characteristic (two-factor view), or, for a continuous characteristic left unbinned, the scatter of expression against it. Call first without group_by to list characteristics[]. csv / recipe write the screen's export. figure_kind heatmap forwards a gene/probe panel to the shared public GEO heatmap tool. Latency: 10 s-3 min cold (matrix download), instant when the series is cached. The figure is the app's GEO › Expression PNG export.

Usage

gf_geo_series_expression(
    session,
    `accession`,
    `annotations` = NULL,
    `binning` = NULL,
    `cluster_columns` = NULL,
    `cluster_rows` = NULL,
    `csv` = NULL,
    `dpi` = NULL,
    `exclude_low_depth` = NULL,
    `exclude_samples` = NULL,
    `figure` = NULL,
    `figure_kind` = NULL,
    `format` = NULL,
    `gene` = NULL,
    `genes` = NULL,
    `geometry` = NULL,
    `group_by` = NULL,
    `height_in` = NULL,
    `html` = NULL,
    `identifier_column` = NULL,
    `inline_image` = NULL,
    `keep_groups` = NULL,
    `low_depth_fraction` = NULL,
    `normalization` = NULL,
    `outline_text` = NULL,
    `output_name` = NULL,
    `preset` = NULL,
    `probe` = NULL,
    `probes` = NULL,
    `recipe` = NULL,
    `secondary_binning` = NULL,
    `secondary_group_by` = NULL,
    `show_caption_color_keys` = NULL,
    `show_dendrograms` = NULL,
    `show_figure_legends` = NULL,
    `show_row_counts` = NULL,
    `size` = NULL,
    `supplementary_file` = NULL,
    `survival_detail` = NULL,
    `survival_median_lines` = NULL,
    `width_in` = NULL,
    `z_normalize` = NULL,
    progress_callback = NULL
)

Arguments

session

A GeneFox session from gf_session.

accession

(string) GEO series accession, e.g. GSE62564.

annotations

(array, optional) NULL omits it.

binning

(string, optional; one of "off", "median_split", "tertiles", "quartiles", "quintiles"; default "off") Quantile bins for numeric group_by. Without bins, a continuous characteristic draws an expression scatter. NULL omits it.

cluster_columns

(boolean, optional; default true) Cluster samples within the measured workload limit. NULL omits it.

cluster_rows

(boolean, optional; default true) Cluster genes within the measured workload limit. NULL omits it.

csv

(boolean, optional; default false) Also write the screen's CSV export (the app's own rows) under the output directory and return csv.path. NULL omits it.

dpi

(integer, optional; default 300; range 72..1200) Resolution of a custom size (at most 8,192 px a side and 16 MP). NULL omits it.

exclude_low_depth

(boolean, optional; default false) For integer counts, drop samples below low_depth_fraction of median library size before normalization; flagged in data.library_sizes and caption. NULL omits it.

exclude_samples

(array, optional) Exclude sample ids from data.points. Exclusions prevent a deep link because saved views do not record them. NULL omits it.

figure

(boolean, optional; default true) Draw the figure and return its PNG path. NULL omits it.

figure_kind

(string, optional; one of "expression", "heatmap"; default "expression") heatmap forwards to the public GEO heatmap tool with genes, probes or preset; expression uses gene or probe. NULL omits it.

format

(string, optional; one of "png", "svg", "tiff"; default "png") Figure format: png (raster, default), svg (vector with editable text), or tiff (raster, .tif); one per run. NULL omits it.

gene

(string, optional) Gene symbol (exactly one of gene and probe). NULL omits it.

genes

(array, optional) Gene symbols, resolved through the series platform annotation; multiple exact-symbol probes use highest whole-source finite-raw sample variance before filtering/normalization, with choices disclosed. Exactly one of genes, probes and preset. NULL omits it.

geometry

(string, optional; one of "box", "strip", "violin", "histogram", "ecdf", "scatter") Distribution: histogram (ungrouped default) or ecdf, including with keep_groups. One factor: box (default), strip or violin (bar and median_bar become box with a caveat). Two factors: box, strip or violin, dodged. Continuous group_by without binning: scatter (default). NULL omits it.

group_by

(string, optional) A characteristic key, copied exactly from characteristics[].untrusted_key of an ungrouped call. NULL omits it.

height_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure height in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

html

(boolean, optional; default false) Write the screen's single-figure HTML export under the output directory and return html.path. Requires figure. NULL omits it.

identifier_column

(string, optional) Key the matrix rows by this supplementary column instead of the inferred one: its exact header text, from geo_supplementary_layout's identifier_candidates. Integrity still applies: a column with repeated or empty values, a sample column, or a header the file lacks is refused (invalid_argument, field identifier_column), never replaced. Reads supplementary files only (the named file, else the ranked walk). Links and recipes record it. NULL omits it.

inline_image

(boolean, optional; default false) Include PNG MCP image content up to 1,048,576 bytes; larger files stay on disk and disclose inline_image_omitted. NULL omits it.

keep_groups

(array, optional) Show only these groups of group_by (for a continuous scatter, of its color, secondary_group_by), copied exactly from a previous call's levels (the screen's group filter). Statistics (r, r², n, the group test and its df) are recomputed on the retained samples with the other levels dropped, as R's droplevels(subset(...)); a level not in the data is refused, never ignored. NULL omits it.

low_depth_fraction

(number, optional; default 0.1; range 0.001..0.999) Low-depth threshold as a fraction of the median library size (default 0.1). NULL omits it.

normalization

(string, optional; one of "raw", "log2", "z_score", "tpm", "cpm", "log_cpm"; default "raw") raw (screen default), cpm or log_cpm (edgeR::cpm, prior.count 2 for log_cpm; column-sum library sizes, no TMM). cpm and log_cpm require non-negative integer counts. NULL omits it.

outline_text

(boolean, optional; default false) With format svg, write labels as glyph outlines instead of editable text. Refused with other formats. NULL omits it.

output_name

(string, optional) Optional figure name replacing tool and title slug: up to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'; starts alphanumeric, no '..'. Session number, size and extension remain; collisions get -2, -3, etc. NULL omits it.

preset

(string, optional) Bundled gene-set preset name; exactly one of genes, probes and preset. NULL omits it.

probe

(string, optional) Matrix row id, e.g. a probe set (exactly one of gene and probe). NULL omits it.

probes

(array, optional) NULL omits it.

recipe

(boolean, optional; default false) Write an app recipe that reopens this analysis and return recipe.path. NULL omits it.

secondary_binning

(string, optional; one of "off", "median_split", "tertiles", "quartiles", "quintiles"; default "off") Quantile binning for a numeric secondary_group_by. NULL omits it.

secondary_group_by

(string, optional) Split groups by another characteristic (descriptive, no test), or color a continuous scatter. Must differ from group_by. NULL omits it.

show_caption_color_keys

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a table caption carries the sentence explaining the figure's colors. NULL omits it.

show_dendrograms

(boolean, optional; default true) Display the trees found by the analysis; never changes order. NULL omits it.

show_figure_legends

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: the figure draws its own legend. NULL omits it.

show_row_counts

(boolean, optional; default true) Figure style: a box plot's row labels carry each group's n. NULL omits it.

size

(string, optional; one of "single_column", "one_and_a_half_column", "double_column", "slide", "poster"; default "double_column") Figure size preset (the app's export presets); double_column is the app default. NULL omits it.

supplementary_file

(string, optional) Exact decoded basename from geo_supplementary_layout; no path, URL, encoding or surrounding whitespace. Only this file is analyzed; no fallback, saved-view links or recipes. NULL omits it.

survival_detail

(string, optional; one of "none", "inference", "inferenceAndEffect", "full"; default "inferenceAndEffect") Figure style: how much of a Kaplan-Meier findings block to draw (the app's Figure Style setting). NULL omits it.

survival_median_lines

(boolean, optional; default false) Figure style: draw dashed median survival guides for reached medians. NULL omits it.

width_in

(number, optional; range 1..40) Custom figure width in inches (with the other side; instead of size). The app's size control range. NULL omits it.

z_normalize

(boolean, optional; default true) Per-gene z-score after base normalization, across retained samples. NULL omits it.

progress_callback

Optional function receiving runtime progress events; NULL disables progress.

Value

A gf_result holding the engine payload, provenance and owned figures for the geo_series_expression tool. The runtime validates every argument and refuses tools absent from its gf_tools() list. Result contract: https://genefox.app/schemas/v1/geo-series-expression-result-v1.schema.json.
